# Speedup Test

Checking how much faster what I've done so far is compared to the original code which used R parallelism for CV.

## Setup

Load the Met Eireann daily data (not available in this Github repo)

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
source("idw.R")
source("ENCE_parallel.R")      # synchronous (parallel) updates
source("ENCE.R")   # Brian's original code

# Load Met Eireann daily data and station geodata file
rain     <- read.csv("~/HPC_Thesis/met_eireann_daily_data/daily_rainfall_2016.csv")
stations <- read.csv("~/HPC_Thesis/met_eireann_daily_data/station_geodata.csv")

# Attach coordinates to each daily observation
rain <- merge(rain, stations[, c("stno", "east", "north")], by = "stno")

# Reshape to the format the rest of the code expects: stno, east, north, t, y
rain <- rain[, c("stno", "east", "north", "t", "rain")]
names(rain)[5] <- "y"

# Sorts the table in place by stno, then t
rain <- rain[order(rain$stno, rain$t), ]

# Compute missingness per station
# Counts the number of observed days per station
obs_per_station <- aggregate(!is.na(rain$y), list(stno = rain$stno), sum)#
# Renames columns
names(obs_per_station) <- c("stno", "n_obs")
# Adds a completeness column = observed days / 366.
obs_per_station$completeness <- obs_per_station$n_obs / 366

# Apply the % cutoff
cutoff <- 0.50
keep   <- obs_per_station$stno[obs_per_station$completeness >= cutoff]
rain   <- rain[rain$stno %in% keep, ]

# Then mask a fraction of the currently-observed cells
set.seed(541)
observed_idx <- which(!is.na(rain$y))
masked_idx   <- sort(sample(observed_idx, length(observed_idx) * 0.25))

df_miss <- rain
df_miss$y[masked_idx] <- NA           # hide masked
```

## Run the original

```{r run-original, message=FALSE, results='hide'}
source("idw.R")
source("ENCE.R")   # Brian's original; needs `...` added to column_impute

n_cores    <- parallel::detectCores() - 1

t0 <- Sys.time()
imp_orig <- ENCE(df_miss, response = "y",
                 max_cycles = 30,
                 nclusters = 4,
                 init_method = "idw",
                 x_name = "east", y_name = "north", t_name = "t",
                 C = 15000,
                 transformation = sqrt,
                 reverse_transformation = function(x) x^2)
t_orig <- Sys.time() - t0
```

## Run the station-parallel version

```{r run-parallel, message=FALSE, results='hide'}
source("ENCE_parallel.R")

t0 <- Sys.time()
imp_par <- ENCE(df_miss, response = "y",
                max_cycles = 30,
                init_method = "idw",
                x_name = "east", y_name = "north", t_name = "t",
                C = 15000,
                transformation = sqrt,
                reverse_transformation = function(x) x^2,
                n_cores = n_cores)
t_par <- Sys.time() - t0
```

## Compare

```{r compare}
t_orig_s <- as.numeric(t_orig, units = "secs")
t_par_s  <- as.numeric(t_par,  units = "secs")

cat(sprintf("Cores:      %d\n\n", n_cores))

cat(sprintf("Original:     %.2f s\n", t_orig_s))
cat(sprintf("Parallel:     %.2f s\n", t_par_s))
cat(sprintf("Speedup:      %.2fx\n\n", t_orig_s / t_par_s))
```
